maps.title: TIME ZONES IN EACH COUNTRY
maps.shortTitle: How Many Time Zones Each Country Has
maps.descriptionNote: Counts include overseas territories (e.g. France 14, USA 11).
maps.notes: verification: REST as fetched 1=224, 2=8, 3plus=15; after KAZ fix + Kosovo drop: 1=224, 2=7, 3plus=15. KAZ corrected 2->1 after Kazakhstan unified on UTC+5 on 2024-03-01 (REST data is stale). Source: Government of Kazakhstan decree, 2024-03-01 (Wikipedia: Time in Kazakhstan). REST counts UTC offsets incl. overseas territories (FRA=14, USA=11, GBR=9, RUS=9, AUS=8, CAN=6, DNK=5, NZL=5), so 'France 14' is the REST/overseas-inclusive count, not mainland. 3plus: AUS=8, BRA=4, CAN=6, DNK=5, FRA=14, GBR=9, GRL=4, IDN=3, KIR=3, MEX=3, NZL=5, PYF=3, RUS=9, UMI=3, USA=11. Antarctica excluded. Kosovo omitted (no ISO numeric code in world-atlas 110m).
